penalties_applied.name: requires_human_fulfillment
penalties_applied.reason: Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud configuration requires per-client hands-on admin/architect work — each implementation is custom and cannot be templated or delivered fully by Claude without a certified Salesforce practitioner reviewing and deploying org-specific metadata.

penalties_applied.name: regulated_industry
penalties_applied.reason: Pharmaceutical and life sciences companies operate under FDA, EMA, and 21 CFR Part 11 compliance requirements; any system tracking field rep coaching visits may need validation documentation and audit trails that require human compliance sign-off.

rationale: The buyers are Salesforce admins and solution architects at pharma companies — real people with budget — but the solution inherently requires certified Salesforce implementation work that Claude cannot autonomously deliver; buildability_with_ai (3) and operational_autonomy (2) both fail their build_gate floors by a wide margin. Layered on top are regulated-industry obligations and per-customer manual fulfillment, driving the total to 1.1. This is a professional services / ISV consulting play, not a solo Claude-factory micro-service.
solution_plan: This opportunity is not viable for a solo non-technical operator running an autonomous Claude factory. Each engagement would require a certified Salesforce Health Cloud architect to design, build, and deploy org-specific metadata, plus compliance documentation for pharma validation — neither can be handled by Claude prompts alone. Drop and do not pursue.
notes: Failing build_gates: operational_autonomy (2, floor 7), buildability_with_ai (3, floor 6). Penalties: requires_human_fulfillment (-1.5), regulated_industry (-1.5). This is a consulting/ISV play requiring Salesforce certification and pharma compliance expertise.
